csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode; public class AttachSpawnHandler { public static string Run() { NetworkManager nm = Object.FindObjectOfType<NetworkManager>(true); if (nm == null || nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab == null) return "No PlayerPrefab"; GameObject prefab = nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab; if (prefab.GetComponent<PlayerSpawnHandler>() == null) { prefab.AddComponent<PlayerSpawnHandler>(); UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(prefab); UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.SaveAssets(); return "Added PlayerSpawnHandler to Player prefab!"; } return "Player prefab already has PlayerSpawnHandler!"; } }
